risks: Changing LoopRD Social auth.mode from public to verified breaks older clients that do not provide guest/user Authorization headers. Operator reports no active users.
LoopRD host must enable trusted Python verifier, advertise the required capabilities, and configure ntfy if device registration is desired.
Windows/Android native compilation and live ntfy delivery have not been executed in this source environment.
LoopRD service credentials must be mounted privately and mapped through LOOPRD_SOCIAL_SERVICE_SECRETS_JSON; do not commit secrets or use LoopRD management bearer inside Tavi.
blockers: Real Android distributor/receiver and provider deployment are not included; background notifications when the app is terminated are not claimed.
notes: looprd.yaml changed to server release 0.3.20, auth verified/durable push, with unchanged application schema version 5; operator Git review/push and LoopRD deployment required.
Both source packages and post-update test stamps declare v0.3.20.
Client WebSocket uses one-time ticket; account tokens never enter WS URLs or game endpoints.
LoopRD Social release is 0.3.22 and schema is 6, with management.data and service.contracts capability requirements.
Trusted service contracts are available in descriptor, but outside applications must declare dependencies and operators must provision matching secret references.
No native administrator dashboard or generic LoopRD administrator role capability was added.
Versioning policy: increment release for all changes, including metadata-only packaging repairs. 0.3.22 supersedes the ZipRunner-rejected 0.3.21; no need to install 0.3.21 first.
